## Handover notes

- `a08-qa--criteria-preflight`: Task result: FAILED with `error` E-CONTRACT when any criterion is untestable, otherwise no handover is needed beyond the next skill. For E-CONTRACT call shared_handover_write with `to_agent` A02, `goal` "make these criteria machine-checkable", `remaining` one line per failing AC id, `blockers` the lint kinds, `constraints` "A08 writes no test until A02 re-issues the criteria", `verification` status `verified` with the lint command in `checks`.
- `a08-qa--criteria-to-suite`: Call shared_handover_write with `to_agent` the requesting agent (usually A01; ids like A05, not slugs), `completed` the AC ids now covered, `remaining` the `uncovered` ids, `artifacts` `{kind: test.suite, uri, digest, producer: A08}` per file, `decisions` any AC you excluded and why, `verification` status `partial` until the gate runs.
- `a08-qa--defect-triage`: Call shared_handover_write to the owner (A05, A06 or A07; ids, not slugs): `goal` "fix the defect", `artifacts` the evidence bundle `{kind, uri, digest, producer: A08}`, `remaining` the repro command, `blockers` the AC id, `open_questions` anything you could not reproduce, `verification` status `verified` when reproduced twice, else `partial`.
- `a08-qa--escape-analysis`: Call shared_handover_write to A01 (and A02 if the cause is a missing or vague criterion): `decisions` the root causes, `remaining` the new tests to author via `skill://a08-qa--criteria-to-suite`, `blockers` the finding ids, `verification` status `verified` with the two rates in `checks`.
- `a08-qa--flake-quarantine`: Call shared_handover_write to A01 (it opens the fix tasks; there is no task-creation tool for A08) with `goal` "fix the quarantined tests", `remaining` one line per test with its fail count and fix owner (A05, A06 or A08), `constraints` "tests stay in the suite, marked, until fixed", `verification` status `verified`.
- `a08-qa--gate-run`: Call shared_handover_write to A01 (it enforces the merge): `completed` the tiers run, `remaining` any `skipped` tier with reason, `blockers` each major or critical finding id, `artifacts` the verdict file `{kind: gate.verdict, uri, digest, producer: A08}`, `verification` status `verified` when every tier the class requires ran, else `partial`.
- `a08-qa--mutation-depth`: Call shared_handover_write to the module owner (A05 or A06) when below the bar: `remaining` the survivor lines and the AC ids needing a stronger assertion, `blockers` the finding id, `verification` status `verified` with the mutation command in `checks`. Above the bar, to A01 with `completed` only.
- `a08-qa--rework-reverify`: Call shared_handover_write to the producer if findings remain (`remaining` each open id with its failing repro, `blockers` the tier, `decisions` which tiers you did not re-run and why) or to A01 when all closed (`completed` closed ids, `verification` status `verified`).
- `a08-qa--risk-tier-plan`: Call shared_handover_write to the agent that will run the gate (usually yourself on the next task, else A01): `goal` "run the quality gate with this plan", `decisions` the class and tier choice with rationale, `constraints` the required tiers and any smoke-only or class-raise request, `remaining` the tiers still to run, `verification` status `partial`.
- `a08-qa--runtime-budget`: Call shared_handover_write to A01: `goal` "decide lane capacity or accept the subset", `decisions` the subset rule with rationale, `remaining` the deferred tests, `constraints` "full suite still required for high risk and release candidates", `verification` status `verified` with the P95 figure in `checks`.
- `a08-qa--suite-lint`: Call shared_handover_write to the suite owner (A05, A06 or A07 by the file's zone) or A01 if mixed: `completed` the checks done, `remaining` each finding id with its fix, `artifacts` none unless you saved the report, `verification` status `verified` with the tool outputs summarised in `checks`.
- `a08-qa--waiver-request`: Call shared_handover_write to A01 (the escalation owner): `goal` "obtain human approval to waive", `blockers` the finding ids, `constraints` "verdict stays fail until a human approves with an expiry; A10 gates are never waived", `open_questions` the missing request fields, `verification` status `verified`.
